analysis_kind: static source review; no DMA/stream/fault reproduced
observations: video_start_streaming iterates from capture sink toward the sensor and enables each subdevice
When a later enable fails, error jumps directly to video_device_pipeline_stop and flush_buffers(QUEUED)
Already enabled downstream stages are not explicitly stopped on this error path
VFE disable calls output stop then reset; output ownership is released only on successful reset
video_stop_streaming returns early on a stop error, before pipeline stop/flush; VB2 ownership and power failure behavior need qualification
retained_contract: docs/runbooks/2026-08-28-e003h-windows-parity-static.md: callable native runner reverse ownership on failure; stop failure pins DMA/pipeline power until reboot
next: Port existing fail-closed owned-resource contract into the standard video start/stop lifecycle; test partial start, sensor error, reset timeout, buffer ownership and power references before one-use RAW hardware run
limits: This source review identifies a missing unwind path; it does not prove an observed memory corruption or hardware failure.
